**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The APCN 2 agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Teleglobe USA Inc.:

- **Only "exclusive" usage** in the document is "sole and exclusive remedy" in Paragraph 27.1 (p0262) — a dispute-resolution/remedies term that belongs under GOVLAW, not a sourcing restriction.
- **Capacity provisions cut in our favour**: Paragraph 12.20 (p0206) and Paragraph 12.22 (p0208) expressly entitle any Party to sell IRU to, and make Allocated Capacity available for use by, other Carriers "without any restrictions"; Paragraphs 15–17 mandate open transiting, interconnection and Direct Access for other Carriers.
- **Non-triggers checked and excluded**: Paragraph 12.21's Management Committee approval for early private IRU sales and the Annex 7 use/Transfer conditions restrict onward resale of our own allocated capacity, not our freedom to procure elsewhere; Paragraph 12.1 ("Capacity of APCN 2 can only be used by a carrier") limits the class of permitted users, not our sourcing.

No redline proposed, as the preferred element is already met and the freedoms in Paragraphs 12.20/12.22 benefit our side.
